§6Pumpjack§f

§aThree times the efficiency, half the depletion. This is your long-term oil extractor.§f

The Pumpjack replaces the Oil Derrick with better numbers across the board. It uses more power but extracts oil §e3×§f faster and depletes deposits at §ehalf§f the rate.

§6Stats§f:
§b• Power§f: §e4kHE/s§f
§b• Oil output§f: §e750mB§f crude + §e50-250mB§f natural gas per §e1.25s§f cycle
§b• Buffers§f: §e64,000mB§f each
§b• Depletion§f: §c2.5%§f chance per cycle

The pumpjack requires oil-derived materials to craft, so you need a derrick first to bootstrap production.

§cWARNING:§f Same drilling hazard as the derrick. §bUranium§f or §bAsbestos§f in the drill path releases poison gas.

§ePS:§f The §e3×§f efficiency advantage means your oil field lasts significantly longer. Upgrade as soon as you can.
